research_question_ko: 공통 운용 과제와 동일한 시장상황에서 AI는 기관별 공개 산업판단을 근거 있는 배분 제안에 어떻게 반영하며, 자료의 초안 전후 제공에 따라 그 연결이 어떻게 달라지는가?
claim_scope: Two-source, single-model documentary case comparison under one market snapshot; not population inference or a test of market-wide harmful homogenization.
historical_run_policy: Preserve all v4.8 failures. Do not pool old/new trajectories, relabel old attempts or select best outputs.
unit: one prespecified source document under one workflow condition; sectors and turns are dependent components

L.D0: no source identity, packet, labels or institutional facts

final_controls.packet_position_meaning: Same final-message block order; absolute token positions and history lengths differ.

estimand: Early prior exposure plus its generated draft/history versus first exposure at final review, conditional on a common final evidence refresh. Not pure memory, anchoring, exposure-count or position effect.
draft_policy: Each case generates its own full 11-sector provisional raw allocation and evidence-linked rationale. No shared L draft and no reset or summary of previous responses.
final_policy: First final response F0 is primary. Retain exact raw draft, actual draft arithmetic feedback, and a fresh complete assigned source packet. Never append post-F0 repair.
calculator_policy: Same deterministic checker in both arms, using only the submitted raw draft and already visible facts. No automatic normalization, residual fill, optimization target, hidden source constraints or semantic verdict.
failure_policy: No retries or replacement. Draft transport, JSON/schema or complete finite-vector failure prevents the dependent final. Raw-sum failures and unsupported output citations/labels remain measured outcomes and do not censor readable drafts. The input visibility boundary is enforced before requests. Never supply hidden reference facts to correct model claims.

budget.basis: Arithmetic of the local design, not a paper-derived optimum or power calculation. No latency reduction is claimed.

data.baseline: Common S&P500 sector comparison benchmark only; new-money task has no existing sector portfolio

market_cutoff.claim: retrospective document-conditioned case, not point-in-time trading replay

data.packet_scope: Existing researcher paraphrases, original rating labels, source IDs and page locators. Original PDFs remain available for review.
data.visibility_rule: Select exactly the assigned public packet; never send the aggregate containing all pilot/main sources.

model.name: Qwen3.5-4B
model.output_limit_basis: PortBench v6 section3.1 transfer, not Qwen4B two-stage optimality. FinVector700 is not adopted for this richer task.
model.context_selection_rule: Before main freeze, measure exact rendered model tokens including retained draft, actual feedback, refreshed packet, template and allowed output. Choose a supported capacity covering the full bound without truncation; log memory and completion. Do not estimate tokens from bytes.
model.backend_rule: Isolate recorded Vulkan failure; compare supported backend operation only as separately logged engineering diagnostics. No GPU stability claim from byte compaction.

semantic_validators_required_before_exec: exactly11 unique allowed sector codes, not merely11 rows
L D0 source_id and source_label null, source_stance not_available, source_evidence_ids empty
E D0 and every F0 bound to assigned source, citations resolved only against already visible evidence
new sectors records extracted unchanged into existing calculator weights input
actual requests exclude all unassigned packets and evaluator artifacts
prohibited_heuristics: post-hoc selection of sectors or documents
pre_main_requirements: supported backend with exact full-history token feasibility and no truncation
separately logged four-case pilot under this context
freeze exact inputs, model, evaluation, execution order and resource ceilings
four_way_allocation_observability: The complete main E/L by source allocation contrast requires four valid F0 portfolios. Otherwise report available prespecified pairs and missing contrasts, and do not claim the allocation question fully answered.
source_contrast_observability: Complete all11 source comparisons before model outputs. Do not infer substantive conflict from different rating vocabularies. If no meaningful source distinction is supported, between-source preservation is not identified; do not fabricate one.
outcome_blind_readiness: Do not require E to win, larger source distance, correct reasoning or every response to be arithmetically valid as a prompt tuning target. Distinguish a runnable instrument from observed valid contrasts.

task.existing_holdings_meaning: No sector portfolio exists within this new-money task; null is not unknown actual institutional holdings.

evidence_items.statement: This is a hypothetical research assignment to recommend a new US equity-sector sleeve, not to impersonate any institution or infer its private mandate.
Use a 2026-07-17 decision reference and only supplied observations and public releases before that date. This is a documentary retrospective case, not a point-in-time trading replay.
The allocation judgment horizon is 12 months. This is not a 12-month realized-return test. Document view dates and horizons remain those of their respective sources.

Propose a reasoned allocation intended for capital appreciation over the stated horizon, explaining diversification and risk-return trade-offs relative to the common sector benchmark. No required return or unique optimal allocation is specified.

The hypothetical assignment accepts equity-market loss risk and provides no capital guarantee. No numerical risk-aversion coefficient, volatility ceiling, loss budget or sector cap is supplied. Do not invent one; discuss remaining risk and uncertainty.

This is new money assigned to an equity sleeve with no existing sector holdings. Recommend target weights, not trades from current holdings. The S&P sector benchmark is only a comparison anchor and is not the starting portfolio.

Use exactly the supplied 11 GICS sector baskets, with one row for each sector including zero weights. The submitted allocation must be long-only, unlevered and fully invested: raw weights sum to one. Individual stocks, cash, bonds and derivatives are outside this sleeve task.

The deliverable is an allocation proposal for review, not a trade order or a whole-client financial plan. Transaction costs, turnover, tax optimization, withdrawals and actual client suitability are not measured. Do not invent missing client or liquidity requirements.

For this hypothetical sleeve there are no scheduled withdrawals during the judgment horizon and no separate ESG exclusion. These are declared task assumptions, not observed facts about a real institution or customer.

Use dated market observations and any institution packet currently supplied. Published outlook ratings are not binding weight constraints or target holdings. Explain justified adoption, qualification or departure and any age/horizon mismatch. Do not assume the outlook author had observed later common market releases.
